Print-Ready Art Direction Deck
April — Complete Master Astrological Compendium • 16 commissioned pen-and-ink illustrations
Deliverable scope: cover, spine, back cover, chapter/section illustration sequence, exact placement, dimensions, mood, lighting, technical notes, gold spot-color callouts, AI reference prompts, production and proofing checklist.
• Built from the uploaded illustration reference guide.
• Designed for illustrator, designer, and printer handoff.
• Uses placeholders/layout callouts rather than generated final art, preserving hand-drawn fidelity.
April Illustration Production Deck • Black ink + Pantone 871 metallic gold • Confidential

Global Style Guide — Must Remain Consistent
• Primary visual language: black pen-and-ink on cream archival paper, with dense Victorian crosshatching and selective antique gold accents.
• Line quality: confident, deliberate contour lines; heavy silhouettes and edges; fine interior texture; shadow depth created by layered crosshatching.
• Lighting: each image must obey one specified dramatic light source; corners may vignette, with luminous centers.
• April: woman in her mid-thirties, dark hair, precise bearing, serious warmth, never defeated; posture carries character when face is unseen.
• Gold usage: only sacred/significant light—Galactic Center, candle flames, star labels, glyphs, decorative borders, crown, dawn elements. Use less rather than more.
• Negative AI prompt for all: no color, no photorealism, no digital painting style, no comic book style, no anime, no flat design, no gradient fills, no soft shading, no watercolor.
April Illustration Production Deck • Black ink + Pantone 871 metallic gold • Confidential

Full Book Wrap — Front, Spine, Back
FRONT COVER• Use Illustration 01 full-bleed 7×9.• Figure in lower two-thirds.• Title occupies upper third.• Galactic Center spiral is the dominant gold accent.• Keep corners vignetted and sky densely hatched.
SPINE• Title set vertically or horizontally per binding.• Small gold Galactic Center glyph centered.• Use black/cream field; avoid busy art at spine fold.• Final width depends on page count/stock.
BACK COVER• Cream/ink field with restrained border.• Small gold spiral or zodiac wheel mark.• Optional short synopsis block and production credit.• Maintain antique manuscript tone.• No competing full illustration unless designer chooses a faint cartographic or star-map texture.

Illustration 01 — The Threshold Between Worlds
Front cover, full page. Leave upper third clear enough for title lockup. • 7" × 9"
• Document location: Cover Page — April: The Complete Master Astrological Compendium
• Page position: Full bleed cover; figure centered in lower two-thirds; title text in upper third
• Purpose: Establishes the document’s visual/emotional register and the scale of April’s chart.
• Mood: Vast — Luminous — Slightly Sacred — Ready
• Light source: The Galactic Center ahead: a luminous spiral on the horizon; sole source of illumination.
• Technical fidelity: Most complex image. Near-full silhouette from behind; dense starfield stippling; gothic stone arch with ivy and zodiac glyphs; essential dark vignette on all four corners. Gold appears most prominently on Galactic Center spiral.
• Gold/spot color: use Pantone 871 metallic gold only where specified by light/glyph/focal element.
• AI/reference prompt: Young woman seen from behind in a gothic stone archway at night, facing vast starfield and luminous Galactic Center spiral on horizon, ivy-covered ruins, zodiac symbols carved in stone floor, Sagittarius/Virgo/Aries constellations visible, dense Victorian crosshatch pen-and-ink, dramatic chiaroscuro, black and white with gold accent, aspect 7:9.

Print Production Specifications
• Interior paper: cream-toned archival quality, ideally 100gsm uncoated; avoid bright white.
• Cover/final full-page art: heavier stock, 200gsm minimum or mounted cover boards for case-bound construction.
• Binding: case-bound with sewn signatures preferred so half/full-page art opens flat without gutter loss.
• Gold: Pantone 871 metallic spot ink recommended; CMYK approximation only as fallback (C:0 M:18 Y:55 K:25).
• Black: rich black for large dark coverage; 100K black for fine linework where appropriate.
• Proofing: verify gold plates, small line retention, title clearances, spine width, and edge bleed before press.
April Illustration Production Deck • Black ink + Pantone 871 metallic gold • Confidential

Final Art QA Checklist
• Every illustration has one dominant specified light source and maintains high-contrast crosshatching.
• April’s posture remains composed, forward-capable, and never defeated.
• Gold appears only on sacred/significant objects: Galactic Center, candles, labels, glyphs, crown, dawn, selected borders.
• All dimensions and document placements match the placement map.
• Illustrations 01 and 16 form a deliberate pair: dark threshold vs dawn forward motion; final image reverses shadows behind her.
• No AI output should be treated as final art unless redrawn/refined to match deliberate pen-and-ink linework.
